info.title: EMHASS API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the EMHASS JSON API. `default` values are sourced from param_definitions.json (the maintainer-declared source of truth); runtime currently loads config_defaults.json, which is kept aligned but not enforced in code.

post.summary: Convert legacy YAML config to JSON

get.summary: Get the per-room weekly thermal comfort schedule

post.summary: Save the per-room weekly thermal comfort schedule

400.description: Invalid JSON body or schedule shape

costfun.title: Cost function
costfun.description: Define the type of cost function.

sensor_power_photovoltaics.title: Sensor power photovoltaic
sensor_power_photovoltaics.description: This is the name of the photovoltaic power-produced sensor in Watts from Home Assistant. For example: ‘sensor.power_photovoltaics’.

sensor_power_photovoltaics_forecast.title: Sensor power photovoltaic forecast
sensor_power_photovoltaics_forecast.description: This is the name of the photovoltaic forecast sensor in Watts from Home Assistant. For example: ‘sensor.p_pv_forecast’.

sensor_power_battery.title: Sensor signed battery power
sensor_power_battery.description: The name of the signed AC-side battery power sensor in Watts from Home Assistant, used by battery self-identification. Either sign convention works (it is auto-detected). Only retrieved when set_use_battery_identification is true. For example: ‘sensor.power_battery’. With number_of_batteries > 1, provide a list of exactly number_of_batteries entity ids, one per battery, index-matched to the battery config lists; a single sensor is never broadcast to more than one battery.

sensor_battery_state_of_charge.title: Sensor battery state of charge
sensor_battery_state_of_charge.description: The name of the measured battery state of charge sensor in percent from Home Assistant, used by battery self-identification. Only retrieved when set_use_battery_identification is true. For example: ‘sensor.battery_state_of_charge’. With number_of_batteries > 1, provide a list of exactly number_of_batteries entity ids, one per battery, index-matched to the battery config lists; a single sensor is never broadcast to more than one battery.

sensor_power_load_no_var_loads.title: Sensor power loads with no variable loads
sensor_power_load_no_var_loads.description: The name of the household power consumption sensor in Watts from Home Assistant. The deferrable loads that we will want to include in the optimization problem should be subtracted from this sensor in HASS. For example: ‘sensor.power_load_no_var_loads’

sensor_replace_zero.title: Sensor to replace NAN values with 0s
sensor_replace_zero.description: The list of retrieved variables that we would want to replace NANs (if they exist) with zeros.

sensor_linear_interp.title: Sensor to replace NAN values with linear interpolation
sensor_linear_interp.description: The list of retrieved variables that we would want to interpolate NANs values using linear interpolation

ssl_no_verify.title: SSL no verify
ssl_no_verify.description: Set to true to disable SSL verification when connecting to Home Assistant. Useful if using self-signed certificates (HTTPS with IP address).

use_websocket.title: Use Home Assistant websocket for data retrieval
use_websocket.description: Enable Home Assistant websocket as data source instead of Home Assistant API. This allows for longer historical data retention and better performance for machine learning models.

use_influxdb.title: Use InfluxDB (1.x) for data retrieval
use_influxdb.description: Enable InfluxDB as data source instead of Home Assistant API. This allows for longer historical data retention and better performance for machine learning models. Only supports version 1.x.

influxdb_host.title: InfluxDB host
influxdb_host.description: The IP address or hostname of your InfluxDB instance. Defaults to localhost.

influxdb_port.title: InfluxDB port
influxdb_port.description: The port number for your InfluxDB instance. Defaults to 8086. (unit: count)

influxdb_database.title: InfluxDB database name
influxdb_database.description: The name of the InfluxDB database containing your Home Assistant data. Defaults to 'homeassistant'.

influxdb_measurement.title: InfluxDB measurement name
influxdb_measurement.description: The measurement name where your sensor data is stored. Defaults to 'W' for the Home Assistant integration.

influxdb_retention_policy.title: InfluxDB retention policy
influxdb_retention_policy.description: The retention policy to use for InfluxDB queries. Defaults to 'autogen'.

influxdb_use_ssl.title: Use HTTPS on InfluxDB connection
influxdb_use_ssl.description: Enables HTTPS on InfluxDB connections. Defaults to 'false'.

influxdb_verify_ssl.title: Verify HTTPS on InfluxDB connection
influxdb_verify_ssl.description: Enables SSL verification of the certificate (e.g. Let's Encrypt) on InfluxDB connections. Defaults to 'false'.

continual_publish.title: Continually publish optimization results
continual_publish.description: set to True to save entities to .json after an optimization run. Then automatically republish the saved entities (with updated current state value) every freq minutes. entity data saved to data_path/entities.

logging_level.title: Logging level
logging_level.description: DEBUG provides detailed diagnostic information, INFO gives general operational messages, WARNING highlights potential issues, and ERROR indicates critical problems that may disrupt functionality.

optimization_time_step.title: Optimization steps per minute (timesteps)
optimization_time_step.description: The time step to resample retrieved data from hass. This parameter is given in minutes. It should not be defined too low or you will run into memory problems when defining the Linear Programming optimization. Defaults to 30 (unit: min)

historic_days_to_retrieve.title: Historic days to retrieve
historic_days_to_retrieve.description: We will retrieve data from now to days_to_retrieve days. Defaults to 2 (unit: days)

load_negative.title: Load negative values
load_negative.description: Set this parameter to True if the retrieved load variable is negative by convention. Defaults to False

set_zero_min.title: Remove Negatives
set_zero_min.description: Set this parameter to True to give a special treatment for a minimum value saturation to zero for power consumption data. Values below zero are replaced by nans. Defaults to True.

method_ts_round.title: Timestamp rounding method
method_ts_round.description: Set the method for timestamp rounding, options are: first, last and nearest.

delta_forecast_daily.title: Number of forecasted days
delta_forecast_daily.description: The number of days for forecasted data; can be overridden at runtime via runtimeparams. Defaults to 1. For naive-mpc, the forecast window is now extended automatically to cover a longer prediction_horizon, so this parameter usually need not be set manually for multi-day MPC runs. (unit: days)

load_forecast_method.title: Load forecast method
load_forecast_method.description: The load forecast method that will be used. The options are ‘csv’ to load a CSV file or ‘naive’ for a simple 1-day persistence model.

mlforecaster_weather_features.title: ML forecaster weather covariate columns
mlforecaster_weather_features.description: Optional list of weather covariate columns to feed the 'mlforecaster' load forecast model as exogenous inputs, in addition to the always-present calendar features. Useful when the load is weather-dependent (e.g. a heat pump). Leave empty to disable (default). Supported values: temp_air, relative_humidity, cloud_cover, wind_speed, ghi, direct_radiation, diffuse_radiation, precipitation, heating_degree, cooling_degree. The values are sourced from the Open-Meteo weather forecast; heating_degree/cooling_degree are derived from the temperature.

set_total_pv_sell.title: PV straight to grid
set_total_pv_sell.description: Set this parameter to true to consider that all the PV power produced is injected to the grid. No direct self-consumption. The default is false, for a system with direct self-consumption.

publish_deferrable_load_states.title: Publish deferrable load command states
publish_deferrable_load_states.description: When true, EMHASS additionally publishes one interpretable command sensor per deferrable load (sensor.p_deferrableN_state) whose state is 'on', 'off' or 'variable' for the current timestep, with the full optimized on/off/variable plan as a 'schedule' attribute. This lets automations act on a clear command instead of thresholding the power forecast themselves. Defaults to false.

num_threads.title: Number of threads to use for the LP solver
num_threads.description: Set the number of threads for the LP solver to use, when supported by the solver. Defaults to 0 (autodetect) (unit: count)

lp_solver_timeout.title: Linear programming solver timeout
lp_solver_timeout.description: Set the maximum time (in seconds) for the LP solver. Defaults to 45. (unit: s)

lp_solver_mip_rel_gap.title: MIP relative gap tolerance
lp_solver_mip_rel_gap.description: For mixed-integer problems (with binary variables), the solver stops when the solution is within this percentage of optimal. Valid range: 0 to 1 (0% to 100%). Higher values (e.g., 0.05 = 5%) solve faster with minimal quality loss. Defaults to 0.01 (within 1% of optimal), which keeps deep-horizon problems from timing out without a published plan. Set to 0 for exact optimal. (unit: fraction)

weather_forecast_method.title: Weather forecast method
weather_forecast_method.description: This will define the weather forecast method that will be used. options are 'open-meteo', 'Solcast', 'solar.forecast' (forecast.solar) and 'csv' to load a CSV file. When loading a CSV file this will be directly considered as the PV power forecast in Watts.

weather_forecast_pv_quantile_bias.title: PV forecast conservative bias
weather_forecast_pv_quantile_bias.description: Blend factor that biases the Solcast PV forecast toward its conservative P10 (low) estimate. 0 (default) uses the central P50 estimate, i.e. unchanged behaviour. 1 uses the P10 estimate. Intermediate values blend linearly: estimate = bias*P10 + (1-bias)*P50. Higher values produce more defensive plans (more battery reserve held when solar is uncertain). Only effective with weather_forecast_method set to solcast. Defaults to 0.

open_meteo_cache_max_age.title: Open-Meteo Cache Max Age
open_meteo_cache_max_age.description: The maximum age, in minutes, of the cached open-meteo json response, after which a new version will be fetched from Open-Meteo. Defaults to 30. (unit: min)

maximum_power_from_grid.title: Max power from grid
maximum_power_from_grid.description: The maximum power that can be supplied by the utility grid in Watts (consumption). Defaults to 9000. (unit: W)

maximum_power_to_grid.title: Max export power to grid
maximum_power_to_grid.description: The maximum power that can be supplied to the utility grid in Watts (injection). Defaults to 9000. (unit: W)

inverter_is_hybrid.title: Inverter is a hybrid
inverter_is_hybrid.description: Set to True to consider that the installation inverter is hybrid for PV and batteries (Default False)

inverter_ac_output_max.title: Max hybrid inverter AC output power
inverter_ac_output_max.description: Maximum hybrid inverter output power from combined PV and battery discharge. (unit: W)

inverter_ac_input_max.title: Max hybrid inverter AC input power
inverter_ac_input_max.description: Maximum hybrid inverter input power from grid to charge battery. (unit: W)

inverter_efficiency_dc_ac.title: Hybrid inverter efficency DC to AC
inverter_efficiency_dc_ac.description: Hybrid inverter efficiency from the DC bus to AC output. (percentage/100) (unit: fraction)

inverter_efficiency_ac_dc.title: Hybrid inverter efficency AC to DC
inverter_efficiency_ac_dc.description: Hybrid inverter efficiency when charging from the AC input to DC bus. (percentage/100) (unit: fraction)

inverter_stress_cost.title: Hybrid Inverter Stress Cost
inverter_stress_cost.description: A virtual cost (Currency/kWh) applied at the inverter's nominal power to penalise high loads. Currently implemented as a quadratic curve (Cost ∝ Power²), incentivising 'low and slow' operation to reduce thermal stress and smooth power flows. (unit: ¤/kWh)

inverter_stress_segments.title: Hybrid Inverter Stress Segments
inverter_stress_segments.description: The number of linear segments used to approximate the stress cost curve. Higher values increase accuracy but may slightly increase computation time. (unit: count)

compute_curtailment.title: Set compute curtailment (grid export limit)
compute_curtailment.description: Set to True to compute a special PV curtailment variable (Default False). When enabled, curtailment that is cost-equivalent is scheduled as late as possible in the optimization horizon

load_cost_forecast_method.title: Load cost method
load_cost_forecast_method.description: Define the method that will be used for load cost forecast. The options are ‘hp_hc_periods’ for peak and non-peak hours contracts, and ‘csv’ to load custom cost from CSV file.

load_peak_hour_periods.title: List peak hour periods
load_peak_hour_periods.description: A list of peak hour periods for load consumption from the grid. This is useful if you have a contract with peak and non-peak hours.

load_peak_hours_cost.title: Peak hours electrical energy cost
load_peak_hours_cost.description: The cost of the electrical energy during peak hours (unit: ¤/kWh)

load_offpeak_hours_cost.title: Off-peak hours electrical energy cost
load_offpeak_hours_cost.description: The cost of the electrical energy during off-peak hours (unit: ¤/kWh)

production_price_forecast_method.title: PV power production price forecast method
production_price_forecast_method.description: Define the method that will be used for PV power production price forecast. This is the price that is paid by the utility for energy injected into the grid. The options are ‘constant’ for a constant fixed value or ‘csv’ to load custom price forecasts from a CSV file.

photovoltaic_production_sell_price.title: Constant PV power production price
photovoltaic_production_sell_price.description: The paid price for energy injected to the grid from excess PV production in currency/kWh. (unit: ¤/kWh)

thermal_gas_price_forecast_method.title: Hybrid gas price method
thermal_gas_price_forecast_method.description: When the heat pump is hybrid, define the gas price as a constant fixed value or read it from a column in the thermal data CSV.

thermal_gas_price.title: Constant gas price
thermal_gas_price.description: Fixed gas price in €/kWh used for hybrid heat-pump gas cost calculations.

thermal_gas_price_col.title: Gas price CSV column
thermal_gas_price_col.description: Column name in the thermal data CSV containing the gas price series in €/kWh when gas price method is set to csv.

set_use_pv.title: Enable PV system
set_use_pv.description: Set to True if we should consider an solar PV system. Defaults to False

set_use_adjusted_pv.title: Enable adjusted PV system
set_use_adjusted_pv.description: Set to True if we should consider an adjusted solar PV system. Defaults to False

adjusted_pv_regression_model.title: Regression model for adjusted PV
adjusted_pv_regression_model.description: Set the type of regression model that will be used to adjust the solar PV production to local conditions. Available models are defined in REGRESSION_METHODS (machine_learning_regressor.py). Defaults to LassoRegression

adjusted_pv_solar_elevation_threshold.title: Solar elevation threshold
adjusted_pv_solar_elevation_threshold.description: This is the solar elevation threshold parameter used to identify the early morning or late evening periods. Defaults to 10. (unit: °)

adjusted_pv_model_max_age.title: Adjusted PV model maximum age
adjusted_pv_model_max_age.description: Maximum age in hours before the adjusted PV regression model is re-fitted. If the saved model is older than this value, a new model will be trained using fresh historical data. Set to 0 to force re-fitting on every call. Defaults to 24 hours (1 day). (unit: h)

set_use_battery_identification.title: Use battery self-identification
set_use_battery_identification.description: Opt-in, default off. When enabled, EMHASS learns the battery usable capacity and round-trip efficiency from Home Assistant history (signed battery power and measured state of charge) instead of relying only on the hand-entered values. It requires set_use_battery to be true and the sensor_power_battery and sensor_battery_state_of_charge sensors. In v1 this is advisory only: it never changes the configured battery values used by the optimizer. Defaults to false.

battery_identification_trust_tier.title: Battery identification trust tier
battery_identification_trust_tier.description: Controls what battery self-identification does with its estimate. 'observe' (default) writes the estimate to a JSON file and the log only. 'suggest' additionally publishes two read-only Home Assistant sensors (identified capacity and round-trip efficiency) and logs a recommendation. Neither tier changes the configured battery values used by the optimizer. Defaults to 'observe'.

battery_identification_model_max_age.title: Battery identification model maximum age
battery_identification_model_max_age.description: Maximum age in hours before the battery identification estimate is re-fitted from fresh Home Assistant history. If the saved result is older than this value, a new estimate is produced. Set to 0 to force re-fitting on every call. Defaults to 24 hours (1 day). (unit: h)

pv_module_model.title: PV module model
pv_module_model.description: The PV module model. Enter the exact CEC database name, or enter the nominal power in Watts (e.g., 300) to automatically use the closest matching panel. Can be a list for mixed orientation systems.

pv_inverter_model.title: PV inverter model
pv_inverter_model.description: The PV inverter model. Enter the exact CEC database name, or enter the nominal AC power in Watts (e.g., 5000) to automatically use the closest matching inverter. Can be a list for mixed orientation systems.

surface_tilt.title: The PV panel tilt
surface_tilt.description: The tilt angle of your solar panels. Defaults to 30. This parameter can be a list of items to enable the simulation of mixed orientation systems. (unit: °)

surface_azimuth.title: The PV azimuth (direction)
surface_azimuth.description: The azimuth of your PV installation. Defaults to 205. This parameter can be a list of items to enable the simulation of mixed orientation systems. (unit: °)

modules_per_string.title: Number of modules per string
modules_per_string.description: The number of modules per string. Defaults to 16. This parameter can be a list of items to enable the simulation of mixed orientation systems. (unit: count)

strings_per_inverter.title: Number of strings per inverter
strings_per_inverter.description: The number of used strings per inverter. Defaults to 1. This parameter can be a list of items to enable the simulation of mixed orientation systems. (unit: count)

number_of_deferrable_loads.title: Number of deferrable loads
number_of_deferrable_loads.description: Define the number of deferrable loads (appliances to shift) to consider. Defaults to 2. (unit: count)

load_names.title: Load names
load_names.description: Name per load tab (for example: Washing Machine, Dishwasher, Pool Pump).

load_washdata_device.title: WashData device slug (optional)
load_washdata_device.description: One per deferrable load - independent of 'Manually-committed load' below, works for any load, automatically dispatched or manual. The device slug used by the WashData 'ha_washdata' custom integration for this appliance (e.g. "wasmachine", matching its sensor.wasmachine_profiel_<program>_aantal / binary_sensor.wasmachine_actief entities). When set, EMHASS discovers every learned program for that device fresh each optimization cycle (unlike most other per-load fields, this is never frozen at config-save time), and uses the most-used program's learned power_profile/power_profile_interval_min - and its implied duration - instead of this load's flat nominal_power_of_deferrable_loads/operating_hours_of_each_deferrable_load. See 'Program select sensor' below to pin a specific program instead of the most-used one. Falls back gracefully to the flat model if no learned program is found yet.

manual_load_enabled.title: Enable manually-committed loads
manual_load_enabled.description: Master switch for the manually-committed load behaviour below. Enables appliances that have no smart-plug control (e.g. a washing machine or dishwasher with only a physical delay-start timer) to be marked manual per-load via 'Manually-committed load'. When a manual load's ready sensor is turned on, EMHASS computes an optimal start time once and publishes it as an instruction - that commitment is then pinned and will not move on later re-optimizations, since the user has already physically set the appliance's timer.

is_manual_load.title: Manually-committed load
is_manual_load.description: One per deferrable load. Enable to treat this load as manually-committed: EMHASS uses this load's own name/nominal power/operating hours (or its resolved WashData profile, if 'WashData device slug' above is set) together with the ready/confirmation/program-select sensors below, instead of scheduling it automatically like a normal deferrable load. Requires 'Enable manually-committed loads' to be on.

manual_load_ready_sensor.title: Ready sensor entity ID
manual_load_ready_sensor.description: One per deferrable load - only used when 'Manually-committed load' is enabled for that load. The Home Assistant entity ID of an input_boolean (or similar) that the user turns on to signal they want this load to run. EMHASS reads this each optimization cycle to decide whether to commit a start time for that load.

manual_load_program_select_sensor.title: Program select sensor entity ID (optional)
manual_load_program_select_sensor.description: One per deferrable load - only used when 'Manually-committed load' is enabled for that load and 'WashData device slug' above resolved more than one learned program. The Home Assistant entity ID of a select you set to the program you're about to run (e.g. select.wasmachine_cyclusprogramma, an entity WashData already provides). EMHASS matches its current option against the discovered programs and pins the plan to that exact one; without it, or while it's left on "auto_detect", EMHASS falls back to the most-used discovered program.

manual_load_deadline_hour.title: Deadline (HH:MM, optional)
manual_load_deadline_hour.description: One per deferrable load - only used when 'Manually-committed load' is enabled for that load. Optional latest time of day this load must be finished by. Leave empty to allow scheduling anywhere in the optimization horizon.

manual_load_confirm_power_sensor.title: Confirmation power sensor entity ID (optional)
manual_load_confirm_power_sensor.description: One per deferrable load - only used when 'Manually-committed load' is enabled for that load. Optional Home Assistant entity ID of a power sensor (e.g. a smart plug that can measure but not safely switch the appliance). When set, EMHASS uses it only to detect that the appliance has actually started, to automatically clear the commitment - never to control the appliance.

start_timesteps_of_each_deferrable_load.title: Deferrable start timestamp
start_timesteps_of_each_deferrable_load.description: The timestep as from which each deferrable load is allowed to operate (if you don’t want the deferrable load to use the whole optimization time window). If you specify a value of 0 (or negative), the deferrable load will be optimized as from the beginning of the complete prediction horizon window. (unit: timesteps)

end_timesteps_of_each_deferrable_load.title: Deferrable end timestamp
end_timesteps_of_each_deferrable_load.description: The timestep before which each deferrable load should operate. The deferrable load is not allowed to operate after the specified time step. If a value of 0 (or negative) is provided, the deferrable load is allowed to operate in the complete optimization window) (unit: timesteps)

load_type.title: Load type
load_type.description: Select the control profile per load: program-based cycle (washer/dryer/dishwasher), fixed power splittable over time (e-bike charging), fixed power non-splittable block, or variable power and variable time.

load_dispatch_mode.title: Dispatch mode
load_dispatch_mode.description: Per-load optimization mode: hours (runtime via operating hours) or energy_kwh (deliver target energy). Program-based sequencing is controlled by the load type itself.

load_programs.title: Program definitions
load_programs.description: For program_based loads: JSON list of programs. Each program has name and power_pattern (comma-separated watts per step).

required_energy_kwh_of_each_deferrable_l.title: Required energy per load (kWh)
required_energy_kwh_of_each_deferrable_l.description: Used when dispatch mode is energy_kwh. Defines energy that must be delivered during the optimization horizon.

nominal_power_of_deferrable_loads.title: Deferrable load nominal power
nominal_power_of_deferrable_loads.description: The nominal (calculated max) power for each deferrable load in Watts. (unit: W)

minimum_power_of_deferrable_loads.title: Deferrable load minimum power
minimum_power_of_deferrable_loads.description: The minimum power for each deferrable load in Watts. (unit: W)

cost_forecast_per_deferrable_load.title: Per-load cost forecast
cost_forecast_per_deferrable_load.description: Optional per-deferrable-load cost forecast track (Currency/kWh) that overrides the shared load_cost_forecast for that load. Useful for hybrid heating setups where one load (gas boiler) is priced against a gas tariff while another (heat pump) is priced against electricity. Pass null/None for any load that should keep the shared tariff. Runtime parameter - not cached.

heat_topology.title: Heat topology (graph model)
heat_topology.description: Declarative directed graph of heat sources, thermal storage, consumers, and flows. When set, EMHASS compiles this into the flat optim_conf primitives (def_load_config, shared_thermal_tanks, deferrable_load_groups, cost_forecast_per_deferrable_load) automatically. Lets you express hybrid heating setups (gas + heat pump feeding the same DHW + buffer) without hand-rolling the deferrable-load indices. See docs/heat_topology.md for the schema.

is_electric_load.title: Per-load electric-bus membership
is_electric_load.description: Per-deferrable-load boolean. True (default) means the load draws from the electric balance (heat pumps, electric heaters). False means the load consumes a non-electric commodity (gas, oil, district heating) and contributes only to its thermal target, not to the electric power balance. Auto-populated by the heat_topology compiler based on source type but can be overridden directly.

operating_hours_of_each_deferrable_load.title: Deferrable load operating hours
operating_hours_of_each_deferrable_load.description: The total number of hours that each deferrable load should operate. Fractional values are accepted (e.g. 4.5) and scheduled as the exact nominal_power * hours of energy; for control finer than the optimization timestep use operating_timesteps_of_each_deferrable_load. (unit: h)

treat_deferrable_load_as_semi_cont.title: Deferrable load as semi-continuous (on/off) variable
treat_deferrable_load_as_semi_cont.description: When configuring a deferrable load, set treat_deferrable_load_as_semi_cont = True if the device should only switch fully on or off (for example, a basic hot water heater), or set treat_deferrable_load_as_semi_cont = False if the device supports variable power control within its range (for example, an EV charger with adjustable charging rate).

set_deferrable_load_single_constant.title: Deferrable load run single constant per optimization
set_deferrable_load_single_constant.description: Define if we should set each deferrable load as a constant fixed value variable with just one startup for each optimization task

set_deferrable_startup_penalty.title: Set deferrable startup penalty
set_deferrable_startup_penalty.description: For penalty P, each time the deferrable load turns on will incur an additional cost of nominal_power (kW) * cost_of_electricity * time step at that time

deferrable_load_max_cost.title: Deferrable load max cost
deferrable_load_max_cost.description: Maximum acceptable cost for scheduling each deferrable load. If the cost to schedule the load (including startup penalty) exceeds this threshold, the load will not be scheduled. Set to 0 to disable and make load scheduling mandatory. (unit: ¤)

set_deferrable_max_startups.title: Maximum startups for deferrable loads
set_deferrable_max_startups.description: Set the maximum number of times each deferrable load can be turned on during the optimization horizon. Set to 0 to disable this limit. (unit: count)

def_minimum_on_time.title: Minimum ON-time for deferrable loads
def_minimum_on_time.description: Per-load minimum number of consecutive optimization timesteps a load must stay ON once started (min-up-time / short-cycle protection). One integer per deferrable load. Set to 0 (default) to disable for that load -- default-off, exact no-op. 1 timestep = optimization_time_step minutes (e.g. 3 timesteps at 30-min resolution = 90 minutes minimum run). Intended primarily for treat_deferrable_load_as_semi_cont loads (heat pumps, AC, pumps) where the ON/OFF binary is tightly coupled to the full nominal power. For plain/continuous-power loads the constraint holds the binary state ON but the power level may be fractional. Composes cleanly with set_deferrable_max_startups (independent constraints). Note: when the minimum ON window cannot fit within the load's operating-window end, the solver simply does not start the load for that horizon rather than forcing infeasibility. (unit: timesteps)

def_minimum_off_time.title: Minimum OFF-time for deferrable loads
def_minimum_off_time.description: Per-load minimum number of consecutive optimization timesteps a load must stay OFF once it stops (min-down-time / short-cycle protection). One integer per deferrable load. Set to 0 (default) to disable for that load -- default-off, exact no-op. 1 timestep = optimization_time_step minutes (e.g. 3 timesteps at 30-min resolution = 90 minutes minimum off-time). Intended primarily for treat_deferrable_load_as_semi_cont loads (heat pumps, AC, compressors) where rapid ON-OFF-ON cycling causes wear or violates manufacturer limits. Composes cleanly with def_minimum_on_time and set_deferrable_max_startups (independent constraints). Note: when the minimum OFF window cannot fit within the remaining horizon, the solver simply defers the next start; the problem stays Optimal. Excludes single-constant and sequence loads (same gating as def_minimum_on_time). (unit: timesteps)

set_use_battery.title: Enable Battery
set_use_battery.description: Set to True if we should consider an energy storage device such as a Li-Ion battery. Defaults to False

number_of_batteries.title: Number of batteries
number_of_batteries.description: Define the number of physical batteries in the plant. Defaults to 1. When greater than 1, every per-battery array parameter below (capacity, power limits, efficiencies, SOC min/max/target, stress cost, weight_battery_charge/discharge, SOC deficit/surplus threshold/cost) accepts either a single scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly this many entries. See docs/config.md for the full broadcast/nesting semantics. (unit: count)

set_nocharge_from_grid.title: Forbid charging battery from grid
set_nocharge_from_grid.description: Set this to true if you want to forbid charging the battery from the grid. The battery will only be charged from excess PV

set_nodischarge_to_grid.title: Forbid battery discharge to the grid
set_nodischarge_to_grid.description: Set this to true if you want to forbid discharging battery power to the grid.

set_battery_first_priority.title: Drain battery before grid import
set_battery_first_priority.description: Set this to true to prefer draining stored battery energy before importing from the grid, so the battery is used up before any import while it is still above its minimum SoC. Useful on a flat (non time-of-use) tariff. This is a soft penalty, not a hard constraint: importing while the battery is charged is heavily penalized so drain-first wins on a flat tariff, but the optimizer can still import when that is the only feasible option, so it will not make the problem infeasible.

set_battery_dynamic.title: Set Battery dynamic (dis)charge power limiting
set_battery_dynamic.description: Set a power dynamic limiting condition to the battery power. This is an additional constraint on the battery dynamic in power per unit of time (timestep), which allows you to set a percentage of the battery’s nominal full power as the maximum power allowed for (dis)charge.

battery_dynamic_max.title: Maximum percentage of battery discharge per hour
battery_dynamic_max.description: The maximum positive (for discharge) allowed power variation (in percentage of battery maximum power) per hour. The solver will automatically scale this limit down based on your chosen timestep duration. (unit: fraction)

battery_dynamic_min.title: Maximum percentage of battery charge per hour
battery_dynamic_min.description: The maximum negative (for charge) allowed power variation (in percentage of battery maximum power) per hour. The solver will automatically scale this limit down based on your chosen timestep duration. (unit: fraction)

weight_battery_discharge.title: Add cost weight for battery discharge
weight_battery_discharge.description: An additional weight (currency/ kWh) applied in the cost function to battery usage for discharging. With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast) or a list of one entry per battery, each entry itself a scalar or a time series - see docs/config.md for the nesting rules. (unit: ¤/kWh)

weight_battery_charge.title: Add cost weight for battery charge
weight_battery_charge.description: An additional weight (currency/ kWh) applied in the cost function to battery usage for charging. With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast) or a list of one entry per battery, each entry itself a scalar or a time series - see docs/config.md for the nesting rules. (unit: ¤/kWh)

battery_discharge_power_max.title: Max battery discharge power
battery_discharge_power_max.description: The maximum discharge power in Watts. With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries. (unit: W)

battery_charge_power_max.title: Max battery charge power
battery_charge_power_max.description: The maximum charge power in Watts. With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries. (unit: W)

battery_discharge_efficiency.title: Battery discharge efficiency
battery_discharge_efficiency.description: The discharge efficiency. (percentage/100). With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries. (unit: fraction)

battery_charge_efficiency.title: Battery charge efficiency
battery_charge_efficiency.description: The charge efficiency. (percentage/100). With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries. (unit: fraction)

battery_nominal_energy_capacity.title: Battery total capacity
battery_nominal_energy_capacity.description: The total capacity of the battery stack in Wh. With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries. (unit: Wh)

battery_minimum_state_of_charge.title: Minimum Battery charge percentage
battery_minimum_state_of_charge.description: The minimum allowable battery state of charge. (percentage/100). With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries. (unit: fraction)

battery_maximum_state_of_charge.title: Maximum Battery charge percentage
battery_maximum_state_of_charge.description: The maximum allowable battery state of charge. (percentage/100). With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries. (unit: fraction)

battery_target_state_of_charge.title: Battery desired percentage after optimization
battery_target_state_of_charge.description: The desired battery state of charge at the end of each optimization cycle. (percentage/100). With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries; also the per-battery fallback target used by the soc_init/soc_final runtime chain. (unit: fraction)

battery_stress_cost.title: Battery Stress Cost
battery_stress_cost.description: A virtual cost (Currency/kWh) applied at the battery's nominal power to penalise high loads. Currently implemented as a quadratic curve (Cost ∝ Power²), incentivising 'low and slow' operation to reduce thermal stress and smooth power flows. With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries. (unit: ¤/kWh)

battery_stress_segments.title: Battery Stress Segments
battery_stress_segments.description: The number of linear segments used to approximate the stress cost curve. Higher values increase accuracy but may slightly increase computation time. (unit: count)

battery_soc_deficit_threshold.title: Battery SOC deficit threshold
battery_soc_deficit_threshold.description: The SOC threshold below which deficit penalties apply. For example, 0.20 for 20% SOC. Penalties are applied for every hour and every kWh the SOC is below this value. With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries.

battery_soc_deficit_cost.title: Battery SOC deficit cost
battery_soc_deficit_cost.description: A virtual cost (Currency/kWh/h) applied for each kWh of SOC deficit per hour. This penalizes periods when the battery SOC falls below the deficit threshold. With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries.

battery_soc_surplus_threshold.title: Battery SOC surplus threshold
battery_soc_surplus_threshold.description: The SOC threshold above which surplus penalties apply. For example, 0.90 for 90% SOC. Penalties are applied for every hour and every kWh the SOC is above this value. Use together with battery_soc_surplus_cost to discourage long dwell near full charge. With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries.

battery_soc_surplus_cost.title: Battery SOC surplus cost
battery_soc_surplus_cost.description: A virtual cost (Currency/kWh/h) applied for each kWh of SOC above the surplus threshold per hour. This penalizes periods when the battery SOC sits above the surplus threshold, delaying charging into expected solar peaks and reducing time spent near full charge (battery longevity). Defaults to 0.0 (disabled). With number_of_batteries > 1, accepts a scalar (broadcast to every battery) or a list of exactly number_of_batteries entries.

capacity_cost_per_kw.title: Capacity (demand) charge cost
capacity_cost_per_kw.description: A cost (currency per kW) applied to the peak grid import power over the optimisation horizon, for tariffs with a capacity or demand charge. 0 (default) disables it and leaves the plan unchanged. A positive value makes the optimiser flatten the import peak, trading it off against energy cost in a single pass. The peak is priced once (it is a power charge, not energy), so set it to the marginal value of shaving 1 kW of peak. (unit: ¤/kW)

ignore_pv_feedback_during_curtailment.title: Ignore PV feedback during curtailment
ignore_pv_feedback_during_curtailment.description: When set to true, prevents PV forecast from being updated with real PV data, avoiding flip-flop behavior during curtailment operations

set_use_heatpump.title: Enable heat pump
set_use_heatpump.description: Set to true to enable heat pump optimization and thermal comfort scheduling.

heatpump_model_family.title: Thermal model family
heatpump_model_family.description: Select the thermal model category: physics, machine learning, or deep learning.

heatpump_is_hybrid.title: Hybrid heat pump (gas + electric)
heatpump_is_hybrid.description: Enable if the system is hybrid (electric heat pump + gas boiler).

heatpump_can_cool.title: Heat pump can cool
heatpump_can_cool.description: Enable if the heat pump supports both heating and cooling.

heatpump_cop_source_sensor.title: Outdoor temperature sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_cop_source_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for outdoor temperature used for COP calculations and weather-curve control. Leave empty to use weather forecast values.

heatpump_weather_ghi_sensor.title: Weather GHI sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_weather_ghi_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for global horizontal irradiance (GHI).

heatpump_weather_dni_sensor.title: Weather DNI sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_weather_dni_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for direct normal irradiance (DNI).

heatpump_weather_dhi_sensor.title: Weather DHI sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_weather_dhi_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for diffuse horizontal irradiance (DHI).

heatpump_weather_wind_speed_sensor.title: Weather wind speed sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_weather_wind_speed_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for wind speed.

heatpump_weather_wind_direction_sensor.title: Weather wind direction sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_weather_wind_direction_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for wind direction.

heatpump_weather_humidity_sensor.title: Weather humidity sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_weather_humidity_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for relative humidity.

heatpump_power_sensor.title: Heat pump electric power sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_power_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for real-time heat pump electrical power in watts.

heatpump_flow_temp_sensor.title: Flow temperature sensor (HA entity, optional)
heatpump_flow_temp_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for measured heating circuit flow temperature in °C.

heatpump_gas_meter_sensor.title: Gas meter sensor (hybrid, HA entity)
heatpump_gas_meter_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for gas usage when hybrid operation is enabled.

heatpump_outdoor_temp_sensor.title: Outdoor temperature sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_outdoor_temp_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for measured outdoor temperature history, used to fit/refit the thermal-mass physics model (heating-model-refit action).

heatpump_duty_sensor.title: Heat pump duty/on-off sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_duty_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for the heat pump's measured on/off or duty-cycle state history, used to fit/refit the thermal-mass physics model (heating-model-refit action).

heatpump_control_mode.title: Control strategy
heatpump_control_mode.description: Choose how the optimizer sets thermal control: weather_curve, thermostat_sensor, or direct_setpoint.

heatpump_target_temp_sensor.title: Thermostat target temperature sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_target_temp_sensor.description: Home Assistant entity_id for the target thermostat temperature. Visible only when control strategy is 'thermostat_sensor'.

heatpump_curve_intercept.title: Weather curve intercept (°C)
heatpump_curve_intercept.description: Weather-curve intercept: flow_temp = slope × outdoor_temp + intercept. Default is 40.0.

heatpump_curve_slope.title: Weather curve slope
heatpump_curve_slope.description: Weather-curve slope. Typically negative (e.g. -1.0): colder outdoor temperature leads to higher flow temperature.

heatpump_max_deviation.title: Max weather-curve deviation (°C)
heatpump_max_deviation.description: Maximum allowed deviation from the weather curve flow temperature.

heatpump_supply_temp_min.title: Minimum flow temperature (°C)
heatpump_supply_temp_min.description: Absolute minimum flow temperature allowed for heat pump operation.

heatpump_supply_temp_max.title: Maximum flow temperature (°C)
heatpump_supply_temp_max.description: Absolute maximum flow temperature allowed for heat pump operation.

heatpump_use_pinn.title: Use PINN thermal model
heatpump_use_pinn.description: Enable Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) based thermal forecasting.

heatpump_pinn_auto_train.title: Auto-train PINN model
heatpump_pinn_auto_train.description: Automatically train the PINN model using historical data. No model path is required.

heatpump_pinn_lookahead.title: PINN lookahead horizon (15-min steps)
heatpump_pinn_lookahead.description: Number of 15-minute steps forecast by the PINN model. Default is 144 (36 hours).

heatpump_use_physics_model.title: Use classical physics model
heatpump_use_physics_model.description: Enable classical physics model inputs (thermal inertia, solar gains, internal gains).

heatpump_nominal_power.title: Nominal power (W)
heatpump_nominal_power.description: Maximum electrical input power of the heat pump in watts.

heatpump_cop_nominal.title: Nominal COP
heatpump_cop_nominal.description: Coefficient of performance under nominal operating conditions (delivered heat / electrical input).

heatpump_thermal_inertia_time_constant.title: Thermal inertia time constant (h)
heatpump_thermal_inertia_time_constant.description: Time constant (hours) describing how fast the building cools when the heat pump is off. Higher values indicate better insulation.

heatpump_window_area.title: Total window area (m²)
heatpump_window_area.description: Total window area used for solar gain estimation. Set to 0 to disable solar gain contribution.

heatpump_shgc.title: Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC)
heatpump_shgc.description: Window solar heat gain coefficient (0-1). Typical double glazing range: 0.4-0.6.

heatpump_internal_gains_factor.title: Internal heat gains (W)
heatpump_internal_gains_factor.description: Constant internal heat gains from occupants and appliances in watts.

heatpump_ml_model_name.title: ML model name
heatpump_ml_model_name.description: Placeholder for future machine-learning model selection.

heatpump_ml_model_path.title: ML model path
heatpump_ml_model_path.description: Placeholder for future machine-learning model path.

heatpump_two_stage_data_csv.title: Two-stage data CSV path
heatpump_two_stage_data_csv.description: CSV path used by the thermal two-stage planner (runtime history + weather/features). Relative paths are resolved from EMHASS root.

heatpump_two_stage_model_dir.title: Two-stage model directory
heatpump_two_stage_model_dir.description: Directory containing classical thermal models and metadata for the two-stage planner.

heatpump_two_stage_horizon.title: Two-stage horizon (timesteps)
heatpump_two_stage_horizon.description: Planning horizon in timesteps used by coarse/fine two-stage evaluation.

heatpump_two_stage_top_k.title: Two-stage top-k candidates
heatpump_two_stage_top_k.description: Number of best coarse models to pass to fine-stage selection.

heatpump_two_stage_coarse_models.title: Two-stage coarse models
heatpump_two_stage_coarse_models.description: Optional model names (comma-separated per entry) to limit coarse-stage evaluation. Leave empty to auto-discover.

heatpump_two_stage_fine_models.title: Two-stage fine models
heatpump_two_stage_fine_models.description: Optional model names (comma-separated per entry) to limit fine-stage evaluation. Leave empty to auto-discover.

heatpump_dl_model_name.title: DL model name
heatpump_dl_model_name.description: Placeholder for future deep-learning model selection.

heatpump_number_of_rooms.title: Number of rooms
heatpump_number_of_rooms.description: Number of controlled rooms. This defines how many room tabs and room-level sensor entries are used.

heatpump_room_names.title: Room name
heatpump_room_names.description: List of room names used for room sub-tab labels. Keep the same order as room sensor arrays.

heatpump_room_temp_sensors.title: Room temperature sensors (HA entities, required)
heatpump_room_temp_sensors.description: Home Assistant temperature sensor entity_ids per room. For multiple sensors in one room, enter a comma-separated list (e.g. sensor.room1_temp_1,sensor.room1_temp_2). Keep room order aligned with room names.

heatpump_room_valve_sensors.title: Room TRV valve position sensors (HA entities, optional)
heatpump_room_valve_sensors.description: Optional HA sensor entity_ids for thermostatic valve position per room. For multiple sensors in one room, enter a comma-separated list. Expected value range is 0 to 1 (0=closed, 1=open).

heatpump_room_blind_sensors.title: Room blind/shading sensors (HA entities, optional)
heatpump_room_blind_sensors.description: Optional HA sensor entity_ids for blind or shading position per room. For multiple sensors in one room, enter a comma-separated list. Expected value range is 0 to 1 (0=open, 1=closed).

heatpump_room_window_sensors.title: Room window sensors (HA entities, optional)
heatpump_room_window_sensors.description: Optional HA binary_sensor entity_ids for room window open/closed state. For multiple sensors in one room, enter a comma-separated list.

heatpump_room_door_sensors.title: Room door sensors (HA entities, optional)
heatpump_room_door_sensors.description: Optional HA binary_sensor entity_ids for room door open/closed state. For multiple sensors in one room, enter a comma-separated list.

heatpump_room_min_temperature.title: Room minimum temperature
heatpump_room_min_temperature.description: Per-room minimum comfort temperature used as a hard thermal_battery constraint. Keep room order aligned with room names. (unit: °C)

heatpump_room_max_temperature.title: Room maximum temperature
heatpump_room_max_temperature.description: Per-room maximum comfort temperature used as a hard thermal_battery constraint. Keep room order aligned with room names. (unit: °C)

heatpump_room_target_temperature.title: Room target temperature
heatpump_room_target_temperature.description: Per-room fallback target temperature, used when no thermal comfort schedule band is configured for a timestep. (unit: °C)

heatpump_room_nominal_power.title: Room nominal power
heatpump_room_nominal_power.description: Per-room nominal heating power used by the thermal_battery model for this room's deferrable load. (unit: W)

heatpump_room_supply_temperature.title: Room supply temperature
heatpump_room_supply_temperature.description: Per-room heating supply/flow temperature used to estimate the heat pump COP for this room's deferrable load. (unit: °C)

heatpump_room_volume.title: Room air volume
heatpump_room_volume.description: Per-room air volume used by the thermal_battery model to convert heat input into a temperature change. (unit: m³)

heatpump_room_shared_group.title: Room shared heat pump group
heatpump_room_shared_group.description: Per-room group id (0 = none) for rooms sharing one physical heat pump. Rooms with the same non-zero group id jointly cannot exceed 'heatpump_nominal_power'.

heatpump_indoor_temp_sensor.title: Whole-house indoor temperature sensor (HA entity)
heatpump_indoor_temp_sensor.description: Home Assistant sensor entity_id for the whole-house heat pump unit's live indoor temperature, used to override the dispatch load's starting temperature each optimization run.

heatpump_dispatch_control_entity.title: Whole-house heat pump on/off entity (HA entity)
heatpump_dispatch_control_entity.description: Home Assistant switch entity_id for the whole-house heat pump's on/off control. EMHASS never calls this entity's service directly - it only publishes a dispatch target sensor for a companion HA automation to apply.

heatpump_dispatch_min_temperature.title: Whole-house dispatch minimum temperature
heatpump_dispatch_min_temperature.description: Minimum indoor temperature used as a hard thermal_battery constraint for the whole-house heat pump dispatch load. (unit: °C)

heatpump_dispatch_max_temperature.title: Whole-house dispatch maximum temperature
heatpump_dispatch_max_temperature.description: Maximum indoor temperature used as a hard thermal_battery constraint for the whole-house heat pump dispatch load. (unit: °C)

heatpump_dispatch_target_temperature.title: Whole-house dispatch target temperature
heatpump_dispatch_target_temperature.description: Fallback target indoor temperature for the whole-house heat pump dispatch load. (unit: °C)

heatpump_dispatch_nominal_power.title: Whole-house dispatch nominal power
heatpump_dispatch_nominal_power.description: Nominal heating power of the whole-house heat pump, used by the thermal_battery model for the dispatch load. (unit: W)

heatpump_dispatch_supply_temperature.title: Whole-house dispatch supply temperature
heatpump_dispatch_supply_temperature.description: Heating supply/flow temperature used to estimate the heat pump COP for the dispatch load. (unit: °C)

heatpump_dispatch_volume.title: Whole-house dispatch air/water volume
heatpump_dispatch_volume.description: Effective volume used by the thermal_battery model to convert heat input into a temperature change for the dispatch load. (unit: m³)

heating_forecast_enabled.title: Enable heating-need forecast
heating_forecast_enabled.description: Publish a forward indoor-temperature forecast (heating assumed off) and a 'heating needed by' sensor, using the fitted thermal-mass physics model. Requires data/thermal_physics_params.json to exist (fit it once with scripts/thermal_mass_physics_model.py).

heating_forecast_horizon_hours.title: Heating forecast horizon
heating_forecast_horizon_hours.description: How far forward to simulate the indoor temperature. Requesting a horizon longer than the weather forecast actually returned (controlled by delta_forecast_daily on the triggering call) is logged as a mismatch rather than failing. (unit: h)

heating_forecast_comfort_min_temp.title: Heating forecast comfort floor
heating_forecast_comfort_min_temp.description: Indoor temperature below which 'heating needed by' fires. Compared against the forecast after the safety margin below is subtracted. (unit: °C)

heating_forecast_safety_margin_c.title: Heating forecast safety margin
heating_forecast_safety_margin_c.description: Defensive offset subtracted from the simulated temperature before the comfort-floor check, so the warning fires earlier rather than later. The physics model has a confirmed tendency to run warm in open-loop simulation. (unit: °C)

heating_model_refit_enabled.title: Enable weekly model auto-refit
heating_model_refit_enabled.description: Periodically refit the thermal-mass physics model's parameters against fresh Home Assistant history (heating-model-refit action) and deploy them for heating-need-forecast to use. Requires use_influxdb (see docs/passing_data.md) since the refit window is longer than Home Assistant's own recorder retention.

heating_model_refit_window_days.title: Refit training window
heating_model_refit_window_days.description: How many days of history to retrieve for each refit. (unit: days)

heating_model_refit_max_mae_c.title: Refit acceptance threshold
heating_model_refit_max_mae_c.description: A refit is only deployed (overwrites the previous fitted parameters) if its room-temperature fit MAE is under this value. A worse fit is logged as an error and the previous parameters are left in place, protecting against deploying a fit from e.g. a sensor outage during the refit window. (unit: °C)

set_use_boiler.title: Enable boiler
set_use_boiler.description: Enable boiler or thermal tank optimization.

number_of_boilers.title: Number of boilers
number_of_boilers.description: Number of DHW storage systems to optimize.

boiler_names.title: Boiler names
boiler_names.description: Boiler labels for diagnostics and logs.

boiler_type.title: Boiler type
boiler_type.description: resistive, hpboiler (heat-pump boiler), or hp_tank_zone (shared with space-heating heat pump).

boiler_temp_sensor.title: Boiler temperature sensor (HA entity)
boiler_temp_sensor.description: Home Assistant sensor entity_id for current boiler water temperature.

boiler_target_temp_sensor.title: Boiler target temperature sensor (HA entity)
boiler_target_temp_sensor.description: Home Assistant sensor entity_id for boiler target temperature.

boiler_volume_l.title: Boiler volume (L)
boiler_volume_l.description: Water volume per boiler in liters.

boiler_supply_temperature.title: Boiler supply temperature (C)
boiler_supply_temperature.description: Supply temperature used to estimate COP for heat-pump based boiler types.

boiler_start_temperature.title: Boiler start temperature (C)
boiler_start_temperature.description: Initial tank temperature at optimization start.

boiler_power_sensor.title: Boiler power sensor (HA entity)
boiler_power_sensor.description: Home Assistant sensor entity_id for current boiler electrical power in watts.

boiler_min_temperature.title: Minimum boiler temperature (°C)
boiler_min_temperature.description: Lower bound for boiler water temperature.

boiler_loss_factor.title: Boiler loss factor
boiler_loss_factor.description: Thermal loss factor per timestep for the tank model.

boiler_dhw_draw_kwh_forecast.title: DHW draw forecast (kWh per step)
boiler_dhw_draw_kwh_forecast.description: CSV or JSON list per boiler defining hot-water draw profile in kWh per timestep.

boiler_legionella_hold_hours.title: Legionella hold duration (h)
boiler_legionella_hold_hours.description: Minimum duration to stay above legionella target temperature.

boiler_legionella_last_run_iso.title: Last legionella cycle (ISO datetime)
boiler_legionella_last_run_iso.description: Last successful anti-legionella timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

boiler_legionella_force_resistive.title: Force resistive during legionella
boiler_legionella_force_resistive.description: When true, forces resistive behavior on due legionella cycles even for HP-based boiler types.

boiler_coupled_heatpump_load_index.title: Coupled space-heating load index
boiler_coupled_heatpump_load_index.description: For hp_tank_zone: index of coupled heatpump deferrable load. -1 disables coupling.

boiler_hp_shared_max_power.title: Shared HP max electrical power (W)
boiler_hp_shared_max_power.description: For hp_tank_zone: shared electrical power cap for boiler + coupled heatpump load.

boiler_uncertainty_margin_kwh.title: Uncertainty margin (kWh)
boiler_uncertainty_margin_kwh.description: Phase-3 hedge margin added to comfort reserves against DHW uncertainty.

boiler_max_temperature.title: Maximum boiler temperature (°C)
boiler_max_temperature.description: Upper bound for boiler water temperature.

set_use_ev_charger.title: Enable EV charging
set_use_ev_charger.description: Enable EV charging settings in the configuration UI.

number_of_ev_chargers.title: Number of charge points
number_of_ev_chargers.description: Number of EV charge points to configure.

ev_charger_names.title: Charge point names
ev_charger_names.description: Name for each EV charge point tab.

ev_charge_mode_service.title: Charge mode select entity
ev_charge_mode_service.description: Home Assistant select entity_id used to set charger mode (for example: select.charge_mode or select.myenergi_zappi_charge_mode).

ev_phase_select_entity.title: Phase selection select entity
ev_phase_select_entity.description: Home Assistant select entity_id used to switch charger phase mode when auto 1/3 phase is enabled (for example: select.phase_selection or select.myenergi_zappi_phase_setting).

ev_charge_mode_stopped_value.title: Mode value for Stopped
ev_charge_mode_stopped_value.description: Required value sent to the charger integration for Stopped mode.

ev_charge_mode_fast_value.title: Mode value for Fast (optional)
ev_charge_mode_fast_value.description: Optional value sent to the charger integration for Fast mode.

ev_charge_mode_eco_value.title: Mode value for Eco (optional)
ev_charge_mode_eco_value.description: Optional value sent to the charger integration for Eco mode.

ev_charge_mode_ecoplus_value.title: Mode value for Eco+ (optional)
ev_charge_mode_ecoplus_value.description: Optional value sent to the charger integration for Eco+ mode.

ev_charge_mode_variable_value.title: Mode value for Variable (optional)
ev_charge_mode_variable_value.description: Optional value sent to the charger integration for Variable mode.

ev_phase_select_value_1_phase.title: Phase select value for 1 phase
ev_phase_select_value_1_phase.description: Value to write to the phase selection select entity for 1-phase charging (for example: 1_phase).

ev_phase_select_value_3_phase.title: Phase select value for 3 phases
ev_phase_select_value_3_phase.description: Value to write to the phase selection select entity for 3-phase charging (for example: 3_phase).

ev_phase_select_value_auto.title: Phase select value for automatic
ev_phase_select_value_auto.description: Value to write to the phase selection select entity for automatic phase switching (for example: automatic).

LastRun.title: EMHASS /api/v1/last-run response
LastRun.description: Response shape for GET /api/v1/last-run. AM-1's openapi generator (board item AM-1) ingests this sidecar alongside other per-endpoint schemas and emits the unified openapi.json. Authored manually until AM-1 lands.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant when the run completed. Null when status='no-run'.

action.description: URL-form action name (matches /action/<name>). Null when status='no-run'.

stage_times.description: Per-stage elapsed seconds, e.g. {pv_forecast: 1.2, load_forecast: 0.5}. Null when status='no-run'.

duration_total_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from optim-wrapper entry to record() call. Null when status='no-run'.

emhass_version.description: Installed emhass package version (importlib.metadata). Null when status='no-run'.

schema_version.description: EMHASS_SCHEMA_VERSION from command_line.py (per AC-1). Null when status='no-run'.

infeasible.description: True when the solver returned Infeasible. Null when status='no-run'.

Plan.title: EMHASS /api/v1/plan response
Plan.description: Response shape for GET /api/v1/plan. The latest optimization plan as JSON records. Columns follow docs/plan_output_schema.md (versioned by emhass_schema_version).

status.description: Discriminator: 'no-run' before any optimization, 'ok' once a plan exists.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant the optimization that produced this plan completed. Equals /api/v1/last-run's timestamp for the same run. Null when status='no-run'.

emhass_schema_version.description: EMHASS_SCHEMA_VERSION. The plan columns follow docs/plan_output_schema.md at this version.

plan.description: Per-timestep optimization records (one object per timestep; columns per docs/plan_output_schema.md, plus a 'timestamp' field). Each record's 'timestamp' is an ISO 8601 UTC instant (Z suffix), the same instant the CSV export and HA publish use, not the configured local timezone — align consumers on UTC, like generated_at. Null when status='no-run'.

Healthz.title: EMHASS /healthz response
Healthz.description: Liveness/readiness probe response. HTTP 200 => status 'ok'; HTTP 503 => status 'degraded'. Health is recency-only; last-run correctness is reported in last_run_status but does not affect status.

last_run_ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC (Z) timestamp of the most recent optimization run, or null if none

last_run_status.description: Raw correctness of the last run (diagnostic only; does not affect status)
